shorts_extract.hook: Wired to the exact same stress clock yesterday, one subject leaps a low wall in two seconds while its yoked partner never tries.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Seligman, Maier & Overmier's 1967 triadic yoked shuttle-box study (~90% escape with control vs 67% passivity without control).
shorts_extract.twist: Maier & Seligman's historic 2016 plot twist: passivity is unlearned brainstem default; MASTERY is what the prefrontal cortex learns.
